name: Bamukuhen Dream
original_name: バームクーヘンドリーム
source:
How many years have passed since then?
That was my late-blooming youth.
Just being next to her made me happy.
Just feeling her presence gave me a sense of fulfillment.

But I broke up with her.

One day, I was regretting breaking up with her.
Suddenly, my ex-girlfriend has time-traveled to the present day!?
